source: Reviewed by hand: an unauthenticated MCP initialize against each address, the vendor's own documentation for any key it takes, and the official MCP Registry (registry.modelcontextprotocol.io) where the vendor published there.

entries.name: Exa
entries.what: Web search built for agents: finds pages and returns their text, so research reads sources rather than links.
entries.note: Answers without a key for light use; heavier use is metered on Exa's side.

entries.name: Microsoft Learn
entries.what: Searches and reads Microsoft's official documentation: Microsoft 365, Azure, Dynamics, Windows and developer products.

entries.name: AWS Knowledge
entries.what: Searches and reads AWS documentation, guidance and regional availability.

entries.name: DeepWiki
entries.what: Reads generated documentation for public GitHub repositories and answers questions about how a project works.

entries.name: Notion
entries.what: Searches, reads and edits pages and databases in your Notion workspace.

entries.name: GitHub (read-only)
entries.what: Reads repositories, issues, pull requests and discussions. The read-only address: nothing on GitHub can be changed through it.
entries.key_help: A GitHub personal access token (github.com/settings/tokens). A fine-grained token limited to the repositories you want read is the safer choice.

entries.name: Linear
entries.what: Finds, creates and updates issues, projects and comments in Linear.

entries.name: Atlassian (Jira and Confluence)
entries.what: Searches and works with Jira issues and Confluence pages.

entries.name: Asana
entries.what: Reads and updates Asana tasks, projects and goals.

entries.name: monday.com
entries.what: Reads and updates boards, items and updates in monday.com.

entries.name: HubSpot
entries.what: Reads contacts, companies, deals and tickets in your HubSpot CRM.

entries.name: Intercom
entries.what: Searches conversations and contacts in Intercom, for support history and customer context.

entries.name: Stripe
entries.what: Reads and changes Stripe data — customers, payments, invoices, subscriptions — and searches Stripe's documentation.
entries.key_help: A Stripe agent API key (Dashboard, Developers, API keys; it carries the Agent badge), limited to what the office should do. From 31 October 2026 Stripe accepts only agent keys here.
entries.note: It can change money-moving data. Review each tool, and mark anything that writes as asking you first.

entries.name: PayPal
entries.what: Works with PayPal invoices, orders, disputes and transactions.

entries.name: Apify
entries.what: Runs Apify's ready-made scrapers and crawlers to collect data from websites that are hard to read directly.
entries.key_help: Your Apify API token (Apify Console, Settings, API and Integrations).
entries.note: Scrapers run on your Apify account and are billed there. The office counts that spend against its limits only if you give the tools a price per call when you review them.

entries.name: Similarweb
entries.what: Website traffic, audience and competitor data: how much a site is visited, from where, and who its rivals are.
entries.note: Answers from your Similarweb plan; what it can see depends on that plan.

entries.name: Semrush
entries.what: Search and keyword data: what people search for, how sites rank, and who competes for the same terms.
entries.note: Calls draw on your Semrush API units.

entries.name: Ahrefs
entries.what: Backlinks, organic keywords and site rankings, for judging a site's search presence and its competitors'.
entries.note: Needs an Ahrefs plan that includes API access.

entries.name: Amplitude (US)
entries.what: Your product analytics: charts, funnels, retention and the events behind them, read from your Amplitude project.

entries.name: Amplitude (EU)
entries.what: The same as Amplitude, for projects kept in Amplitude's EU data centre.

entries.name: Pendo
entries.what: Product usage and feedback: which features are used, by whom, and what users ask for.

entries.name: Context7
entries.what: Current documentation and code examples for software libraries, by version, so answers about a library are not out of date.
entries.note: Answers without a key for light use; a Context7 key raises the limits.

entries.name: Hugging Face
entries.what: Searches models, datasets, papers and Spaces on Hugging Face, and reads their cards.
entries.note: Public search needs no sign-in; a Hugging Face token as the key reaches what your account can see.

entries.name: ClickUp
entries.what: Reads and updates tasks, lists, docs and comments in your ClickUp workspace.
entries.note: It can change tasks. Mark anything that writes as asking you first.

entries.name: Airtable
entries.what: Reads and edits the bases, tables and records you choose to share with it.
entries.note: It can change records. Mark anything that writes as asking you first.

entries.name: Miro
entries.what: Reads boards and their stickies, frames and diagrams, and can add to a board.

entries.name: Sentry
entries.what: Errors and performance issues from your applications: what broke, how often, for whom, with the stack trace.

entries.name: Zapier
entries.what: Reaches the apps you have connected in Zapier (thousands of them), through the actions you choose to expose there.
entries.note: Every action you expose in Zapier can act in that app, and uses your Zapier tasks. Expose only what the office needs, and mark anything that writes as asking you first.

entries.name: Canva
entries.what: Finds, reads and creates designs in your Canva account, and exports them.

entries.name: Gamma
entries.what: Turns an outline or a finished report into a presentation, document or web page in Gamma.
entries.note: Making something uses your Gamma credits.

entries.name: Dropbox
entries.what: Searches and reads the files in your Dropbox.

entries.name: Box
entries.what: Searches and reads the files in your Box.
entries.note: Box issues each app its own credentials by hand, so the office cannot sign itself in yet.

entries.name: Webflow
entries.what: Reads and edits your Webflow sites: pages, CMS collections and their items.
entries.note: It can change a live site. Mark anything that writes as asking you first.

entries.name: Wix
entries.what: Reads and manages your Wix sites and their business data: products, bookings, contacts.
entries.note: It can change a live site. Mark anything that writes as asking you first.

entries.name: Fireflies
entries.what: Your meeting transcripts and summaries: what was said, decided and assigned, searchable across meetings.

entries.name: Slack
entries.what: Searches and reads messages and channels in your Slack workspace.
entries.note: Slack's server accepts only apps Slack has registered in advance, so the office cannot sign itself in. Your office's own Slack bot (Connections) already brings Slack to the office.

entries.name: Square
entries.what: Reads and manages Square data: payments, orders, catalog, customers.
entries.note: It can change money-moving data. Review each tool, and mark anything that writes as asking you first.
